description: This file defines the BookmarksViewModel class for managing bookmark-related UI state and interactions in an Android app, including observing bookmarked resources, removing, undoing removal, and marking resources as viewed.

classes.name: BookmarksViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing bookmark UI state, including observing bookmarks, removing, undoing, and marking resources as viewed.

methods.name: removeFromSavedResources
methods.description: Removes a news resource from saved bookmarks and updates UI state.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed or not viewed.

methods.name: undoBookmarkRemoval
methods.description: Restores the last removed bookmark if undo is triggered.
